best_channel: Submit the 'Pitch Us' Typeform on seedcamp.com; the FAQ says the process starts with an initial call with the team, then a 45-minute partner pitch.

name: Rainmatter (Zerodha)
stage: Not stage-based. Site: 'we think of businesses holistically in terms of people running the show'. Check range starts at INR 50 lakhs, which covers pre-seed. Idea stage not explicitly excluded; 'Think your idea fits? Let's talk'.
check_size: 'Rs 50 lakhs to Rs 100 crores' (site text: '₹50 lakhs to ₹100 crores')
best_channel: Submit the Google Form linked on rainmatter.com; the site invites direct applications ('Think your idea fits? Let's talk').
cold_pitch_policy: 'Think your idea fits? Let's talk' (rainmatter.com); no restriction stated
notes: Highly relevant portfolio for trading tools: Sensibull (options trading), Streak (algo backtesting and deployment without coding), Kambala, Kalpi (equity screening), smallcase, Capitalmind, Tijori, Prime Investor, Indus (global investors into Indian markets), Quicko. 'patient long-term investors', 'don't take board seats'. Blog post: 'What will the future of trading and investing look like?'. India focus; a Polymarket bot may not fit Indian regulation.

name: Y Combinator
sectors: Sector-agnostic; deep fintech, crypto, AI, and trading portfolio
stage: Idea stage accepted. FAQ: 'On average, 40% of the companies we fund in each batch are just an idea. Most don't have any revenue.' 'We regularly accept solo founders.' 'the majority of the companies we fund will always be companies at the very earliest stage.'
check_size: '$500,000' standard deal: '$125,000 of our investment converts into a fixed 7%' plus '$375,000 is invested on an uncapped MFN SAFE'
geography: Global applicants; program in San Francisco
best_channel: Apply online at apply.ycombinator.com; on-time deadline shown as 'November 2 at 8pm PT' with decisions 'by December 11'; late applications still considered.
cold_pitch_policy: Open application. FAQ: 'We recommend applying for YC as soon as you have a founding team and an idea you are excited about.'
notes: Directly relevant YC fintech companies: Arbital (perps, memes, stocks, market-making), Spectre Intelligence ('We create AI traders'), Prodigy Research (AI trading research lab), KelAI ('autonomous alpha engine for hedge funds'), Standard Signal (AI-run hedge fund), Kimpton AI, ValCtrl ('intelligent prediction market'), River Markets (prime brokerage aggregating prediction market venues), Instinct (Hyperliquid mobile trading), Mochatrade, Agentcard (debit card for AI agents), Levocred AI, TovenAI, Coinbase. 'The YC investment is not contingent on hitting any milestones.'
